component.name: LGL Games Launcher
component.summary: A local Steam and Faugus game library for Fedora

description.p: LGL Games Launcher discovers Steam games from local manifests and Faugus games from its local library, presents them in a GTK library, and launches them through Steam or Faugus. Faugus entries include the Ubisoft Connect, EA App and Epic Games launchers it manages, plus the games those clients installed. Optional Epic and Ubisoft Connect sign-in lists owned games, installed or not.
Everything is local. Other launchers, direct store account libraries, emulators, playtime recording, Game Mode, saves, backups and streaming are not part of this build.
Trim the About dialog credits to the copyright holders required by the licence.
Ubisoft Connect sign-in, owned library, covers and launching.
Faugus library discovery, store launchers and a source filter.
Initial Steam-only MVP: discovery, library browsing, details and launch.
